title: Release download queue
subtitle: Tills take turns to download a POS release. See who is downloading, who is waiting, what finished and how far each release has spread.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the release download queue
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant to view the release download queue. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

read.failed: HQ did not answer. The page tries again shortly.
read.denied: Your account does not hold the grant to view the release download queue.

pool.heading: Download pool
pool.paused: Paused: no till may start a download

manage.failedHint: HQ did not answer. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.

refusal.outOfRange: The size must be a whole number from 0 (pause) to 500.
refusal.noUser: Your session has no signed-in user. Sign in again, then retry.
refusal.busy: The pool was deciding a grant. Try again in a moment.

confirm.pauseNote: With the pool at 0, no till in any store may start a release download until someone raises it again. Waiting tills keep their place in the queue.
confirm.resumeNote: Waiting tills are served in the order they first asked.
confirm.resizeNote: Tills are granted slots up to the new size. A smaller pool takes no slot away; it fills only as slots end.
confirm.active: Tills already downloading keep their slots: <n>{{n}}</n>.
confirm.moved: The pool changed while this was open: it is now <now>{{now}}</now>. Check this is still the change you want.
confirm.movedToSame: The pool changed while this was open: it is already <to>{{to}}</to>, so applying changes nothing.

done.same: The pool is already {{size}}. Nothing changed.

free.title: Free the slot of till {{till}}?
free.note: The till cancels its download at its next renewal, and the slot goes to the next waiting till. Use this for a till that is stuck.
free.notLive: The slot of till {{till}} had already ended
free.notLiveHint: It finished, failed or expired before the free reached HQ. Nothing was changed.

slots.heading: Live slots
slots.empty: No till is downloading right now.

queue.heading: Queue
queue.storesHeading: Stores in the order they are served
queue.empty: No till is waiting for a slot.

history.heading: History
history.empty: No finished download matches these filters.

convergence.heading: Convergence
convergence.note: Per release, from the download slots: tills that downloaded it, are downloading it, or are waiting for it.
convergence.empty: No release has been asked for yet.
